attributes.title: Camera
attributes.lede: The whole library sits on the glass. Dive in to grade a shot.

lesson.concept: Move the view to explain a relationship
lesson.why: Framing computes pan and zoom from resting layout bounds. The selected photo remains part of the same collection, and the callout appears beside the frame rather than covering the subject.
lesson.experiment: Select a second photo during the dive. Observe whether its final framing uses the photo's real bounds rather than its transient screen position.
lesson.pitfall: Measuring a transformed intermediate box can feed camera motion back into its own next target.
lesson.combine: Combine with spatial paths when several purposeful framings should form a guided route.
